comments.text: The poorest country in the western hemisphere? How do I start to address this dilemma? Hispaniola as an island, was never meant to be divided into two countries. Our (my family) living quarter was one room. Modern comfort when I became aware of the term was food for thought. To make a long story short: Haitians more than ever must deal with lack of employment, lack of sufficient food, no mass transit among other basic necessities for a balanced lifestyle. No free public education and health care as amended by the constitution. The dire straight episodes of misery and indifference Haitians have been subjected to while the civilized world looks the other way and question those Haitian customs that are impossible to comprehend. Today, I live in New York State and wonder if I'll ever be able to go back.
